rules:
You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Ben, Eli, Dev, Ada, Fay, Cal. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 2 and 6 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Ben.say: Ben here. There are 6 villagers and only 6 rations plus 2-6 per day, so we cannot all last 5 nights. Each person needs 5 rations to survive. I propose we concentrate supplies so as many people as possible survive, rather than everyone holding a few and all starving. I am claiming 5 today, which is exactly enough for me to last all 5 nights. Please say what you hold and what you plan to claim, so we can decide together who gets support each day.

Eli.say: Eli here. Math check: the storehouse has 6 now plus 2-6 arriving each day, so roughly 26 rations total over 5 days, but all six of us need 30 to last. Not everyone can make it unless we coordinate. Proposal: claim only what you can actually use, and once rations are in hand, let's pool them so that as many of us as possible reach 5. I'm claiming 6 today and will hold whatever I receive so we can decide together who needs it most. Please post your holdings and claims.

Dev.say: Dev here. The storehouse can't feed all six of us for all five nights: we need 30 rations in total and expect roughly 26 across the whole period. Proposal: whoever claims now keeps enough to last, and anyone with spare rations later gives them to villagers who are running short, so the most people survive. I'm claiming 5 today, which is exactly what I need to last all five nights. Please say what you're claiming so we can plan the rest.

Ada.say: Day 1. Total need is 30 rations (6 people x 5 nights) but supply is only about 26 over the whole stay, so not everyone can last. Let's coordinate: claim only what you can actually use, and avoid over-claiming, which gets split and wastes rations. I'm claiming 5 today. Anyone who ends up holding spare rations later, please give them to whoever is closest to running out.

Fay.say: Fay here. Total need is 30 rations and we only get about 6 plus 2-6 a day, so not everyone can last 5 nights. I'm claiming 6 today to secure my own survival. Once I have 5 for my nights, I'll give any surplus to whoever is at the greatest risk. Suggest everyone else post your holdings and needs so we can decide who gets the next claims.

Cal.say: Cal here. Storehouse is 6 now plus 2-6 delivered today, and we all need 5 rations each to last the 5 nights. Total supply won't cover all six of us, so I propose we concentrate rations on whoever is closest to surviving, rather than splitting thin and losing everyone. I'm claiming 6 today. Please say how many you're claiming so we can plan who gets fed.

Ben.say: Ben here. Yesterday everyone over-claimed, so the storehouse was split thin and nobody got enough, and we now hold almost nothing. Right now Eli and Cal each hold 1 and need only 3 more each to last the 4 nights. Everyone else needs 4 from zero. With about 2-6 arriving per day, we can realistically save only two or three people, so we should concentrate on the cheapest survivors. My proposal: Eli and Cal claim 3 each today. I am claiming 0 so that the delivery is not split. I will support whoever is closest to surviving with anything I receive later. Please keep your claims to exactly what you need, and post what you hold.

Eli.say: Eli here. Current state: Eli 1, Cal 1, everyone else 0, storehouse 0 this morning, delivery 2 so far. Remaining supply from now to the end is roughly 2 + 4 more deliveries (about 18 total), but 6 people still need about 22, so we cannot all last. Anyone holding 0 will need a ration by tonight, and the only source is today's delivery. I'm claiming 3, which is exactly what I need beyond my 1 to last all 4 nights. Proposal: Cal, if you claim, claim only what you need beyond your 1. Anyone who ends up with a surplus on later days should pass it to whoever is closest to running out, and let's agree on who the survivors will be before the next claims so we don't waste rations splitting.

Dev.say: Dev here. Current state: the storehouse is empty, and only Eli and Cal hold a ration (1 each). Everyone else needs 4 more rations to last the remaining nights, and today's delivery is 2 to 6. Since claims split proportionally, several claimants waste rations.
